tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250sman gyi brgyud mchod ni/1$0000300 dbyings kyi yum chen kun bzang mo// rdo rje btsun mo gnam zhal ma// rab dgyes khros ma nag mo la// sman mchod 'bul lo dngos grub stsol// ma hā pañtsa a mṛta kha kha khā hi/ rje btsun pad+ma thod phreng rtsal// ye shes mtsho rgyal khri srong rje// ḍā ki pad+ma mtsho skyid la// sman mchod 'bul lo dngos grub stsol// ma hā pañtsa a mṛta kha kha khā hi/ pad+ma 'od gsal mdo sngags gling*// rtsa brgyud rig 'dzin bla ma dang*// yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la// sman mchod 'bul lo dngos grub stsol// ma hā pañtsa a mṛta kha kha khā hi/ rdo rje rin chen pad+ma las// gnas yul dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma// dam tshig 'byung ba'i mkha' 'gro la// sman mchod 'bul lo dngos grub stsol// ma hā pañtsa a mṛta kha kha khā hi/ spyang zhon chen mo mched gsum sogs// bka' gter srung ma rgya mtsho dang// 'bum phrag yangs pa'i 'khor tshogs la// sman mchod 'bul lo dngos grub stsol// ma hā pañtsa a mṛta kha kha khā hi/
ces pa'ang blo gros mtha' yas kyis so//
